source_text: Fames in terra; Isaac ad Abimelech Geraris. Dominus: noli descendere in Aegyptum — mane in terra quam dixero.
pass_a_gloss: Famine in land; Isaac to Abimelech of-Gerar. Lord: do-not go-down into Egypt — remain in land which I-will-say.
pass_b_english: [[Famine in the land; Isaac goes to Abimelech at Gerar >> Bible:Genesis 26:1]]. The Lord: [[Do not go down to Egypt; stay in the land I name >> Bible:Genesis 26:2]].
